dedupe_keys.name: building level day and night population exposure notebook

description: This repository publishes a Jupyter notebook that allocates WorldPop gridded population to individual buildings. It combines building footprints, OpenStreetMap building types and CORESIDENCE household-size information to generate daytime and nighttime occupancy and exposure estimates. The README lists Python, GeoPandas, Rasterio, Pandas, NumPy, Shapely and Matplotlib dependencies. The tree includes an example settlement footprint, OSM building files, a population raster and the notebook. A modeller could use the workflow to make exposure populations for evacuation or hazard scenarios where census totals alone are too coarse. The README does not state an observation date for its example or measured accuracy, and the notebook was not run during this review. Its examples are not evidence that daytime and nighttime occupancy were validated against people counts. The repository licence is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. That restriction limits redistribution of adapted code, and the included WorldPop, OSM and CORESIDENCE source data may have separate conditions. Check those conditions before republishing any derived database or modified notebook. The project authors publish a regional example, but the README does not state the exact geographic coverage or source years for the included files.
